payload.title: Main (main) Notebook
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook is designed to generate all figures for the manuscript by Cropper et al. (2023). It utilizes various scientific computing libraries to process climate model data and produce visualizations. The notebook includes functions for detrending data, calculating autocorrelation, and performing linear regression. It processes datasets related to climate models and paleoclimate reconstructions to compare model outputs and analyze emergent constraints.
goals: Generate figures for the manuscript by Cropper et al. (2023).
Analyze emergent relationships in climate model ensembles.
Compare climate models to paleoclimate reconstructions.

section_blurbs.blurb: The main notebook sets up the environment and imports necessary libraries for generating figures from the manuscript. It includes functions for data processing and visualization.
